newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen resuming upward path after fall.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen resuming upward path after fall.

text.p: Danish share prices opened higher on Thursday and dealers saw them continuing to climb back up after being battered by profit-taking on Wednesday.
"The Dow Jones will radiate positive sentiment, with the banks and A.P. Moeller in focus," a dealer said.

Banks and insurance have been at the centre of attention for some time and A.P. Moeller, traditionally secretive, told visiting analysts on Wednesday it was considering more openness toward investors.
The KFX top-20 index opened 0.10 point up at 121.20. --Claus Mathisen, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969650
